info.name: Kylas APIs Public
info.description:
#### The API collection contains all required APIs to perform allowed operations on Kylas account. Each of the requests have documentation helping user to understand the payload of API.



#### API KEY can be found [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/integrations/api-keys/list)

#### For product details and its ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/products-services/list)

#### Find Lead form field value Ids as below:
* For pipeline id and stage ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/leads/pipelines/list)
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/leads/list)


#### Find Deal form field value Ids as below:
* For pipeline id and stage ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/deals/pipelines/list)
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/deals/list)

#### Find Contact form field value Ids as below:
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/contacts/list)

#### Find Company form field value Ids as below:
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/companies/list)


#### Find Meeting form field value Ids as below:
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/meetings/list)

request.description:
#### Update lead currently is a PUT request and It is a 3 step process for now
 
1. Fetch lead details using 'Get lead details' API.
2. From above request's response, update those fields which you want.
3. Copy paste the new payload in Update lead request's body and hit 'Send' request.

#### API KEY can be found [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/integrations/api-keys/list)

#### Find Ids as below:
* For pipeline id and stage ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/leads/pipelines/list)
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/leads/list)
* For product details and its ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/products-services/list)

{"id":59217}

#### Update deal currently is a PUT request and It is a 3 step process for now
 
1. Fetch deal details using 'Get deal details' API.
2. From above request's response, update those fields which you want.

#### Update Company currently is a PUT request and It is a 3 step process for now
 
1. Fetch company details using 'Get company details' API.
2. From above request's response, update those fields which you want.
3. Copy paste the new payload in Update company request's body and hit 'Send'.

#### API KEY can be found [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/integrations/api-keys/list)

Company ID can be found in company details page url.

#### Find Ids as below:
* For any form field details like picklist value ids, Company type ids, Campaign, Source, any Custom fields and their value ids visit [here](https://app.kylas.io/setup/fields/companies/list)
